items.text: Set up Cloudflare so the dashboard has a private web address
items.how: On your phone, about 10 minutes. 1) dash.cloudflare.com: sign in or create a free account; note the Account ID (Workers & Pages page, right side). 2) My Profile > API Tokens > Create Token > Create Custom Token. Permissions: Account > Cloudflare Pages > Edit; Account > Access: Apps and Policies > Edit; Account > Account Settings > Read. Account Resources: your account. Copy the token once. 3) Zero Trust (left menu): pick the Free plan and a team name if asked. 4) At a computer, run: gh secret set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN -R donlafranchi/socialus-plan, then the same for CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID (gh asks for the value; nothing is printed). Or GitHub > socialus-plan > Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > New repository secret, on the phone. 5) GitHub > socialus-plan > Actions > 'cloudflare setup' > Run workflow (once; it creates the site and locks it to mrlafranchi@gmail.com), then 'cloudflare dashboard' > Run workflow. Opening it emails you a one-time code.
items.unlocks: Your dashboard on Cloudflare, behind your email only (the GitHub Pages copy stays until this works)

queue.how:
Phone, socialus.org. You need THREE accounts: your main (owns the Page), a second email, and a third. A Gmail '+' address works as the third, e.g. yourname+two@gmail.com: same inbox, counts as a different member. Sign in on the second and third with the 6-digit code from the email; never use a builder account (they never send notices).
1. Second account: open a Page your main account owns, tap ⋯ → Report this Page, pick Spam (NOT Sensitive content or Threat of harm: those hide at once), type 'TEST', Send. Page stays up.
2. Main account: open You. A courtesy notice about the report is there, and the Page still shows its name and description.
3. Second account again: report the same Page a second time. Nothing changes (the same person twice does not count; a third try says you already reported it). Fine.
4. Third account: report the same Page, Spam, 'TEST'. Now a second member has reported it: the name and description disappear for everyone, the Page stays up, and your main account gets a 'hidden' notice.
5. Undo: in Admin → Reports, restore the Page's words.
Then tell an agent 'F078 test done': it checks the AI shadow row and closes #220 and #486's check.
queue.unlocks: Closes web #220, proves the AI shadow read runs (#486), and unblocks the moderation work
